description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the ~/memory/ architecture. (2) Create ~/memory/ in the HOME directory (NOT inside /workspace/). (3) Create ~/memory/config.md and ~/memory/INDEX.md listing all 4 categories. (4) Create ~/memory/people/, ~/memory/grants/, and ~/memory/publications/ — each with a properly formatted INDEX.md markdown table and individual .md files for each entry. (5) CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: The equipment inventory has 150 items, which exceeds the 100-entry INDEX.md limit specified in Rule 7 ('Scale by Splitting'). The agent MUST split ~/memory/equipment/ into at least 2 subcategories (e.g., lab/ and field/), each with their own INDEX.md, while the root ~/memory/equipment/INDEX.md must point to the subcategories rather than directly listing all 150 items. Agents relying on general knowledge will likely dump all items into a single flat INDEX.md. (6) Never touch /workspace/MEMORY.md or /workspace/memory/ (the built-in agent memory protected files). An agent that hasn't read the SKILL.md will not know about the ~/memory/ home path, the required INDEX.md table format, the 100-entry split threshold, or the protected workspace memory separation rule.
